# UC Libraries LibApps

> A comprehensive digital collections and exhibits platform showcasing University of Cincinnati's rare books, archives, special collections, and historical research materials.

UC Libraries LibApps serves as a gateway to the university's digital heritage collections, including the Archives and Rare Books (ARB) Library. The platform features curated digital exhibits, manuscript collections, and special archives documenting local Cincinnati history, cultural heritage, and significant historical figures and events.

## Key Topics

- Digital Exhibits
- Archives and Rare Books Library (ARB)
- Special Collections
- Rare Books
- Manuscript Collections
- Cincinnati Local History
- Cultural Heritage
- University of Cincinnati
- William Howard Taft
- German-Americana Collection
- Irish Literature Collection
- Historical Photographs
- Utopian Architecture
- Diplomatic History
- Southwest Ohio Folklore

## Digital Exhibits

- [ARB Exhibits - Archives and Rare Books Library](https://libapps.libraries.uc.edu/exhibits): Digital exhibits from ARB Library featuring rare books, archives, and special collections
- [Looking East: William Howard Taft and the 1905 U.S. Diplomatic Mission to Asia](https://libapps.libraries.uc.edu/lookingeast/index.html): Digital exhibit on Taft's 1905 diplomatic mission to Asia with historical photographs
- [Victory City: The City of the Future](https://libapps.libraries.uc.edu/victorycities): Digital exhibit on Victory City utopian architecture concept by Orville Simpson II

## Collections & Partnerships

- [UC Libraries International Partnerships](https://libapps.libraries.uc.edu/source): UC Libraries international partnerships and collaborations with global universities
